task.description: REQ-233: retire R-Co parity-justification phrasing ('matches R-Co'/'mirrors R-Co'/'same as R-Co'/"R-Co's own"/'R-Co own'/'parity'/'port of R-Co') from comments and moduledocs across the 13 flagged files under lib/letflow/engine.ex, lib/letflow/engine/, engine/wasm/, engine/lua/. Per occurrence, either restated on Letflow's own technical merit (the real invariant, N+1-avoidance reason, extensibility reason, scope boundary, etc.) or trimmed a purely stylistic 'own'/'parity' word where the surrounding sentence was a citation, not a justification. Also fixed one pre-existing incidental test-name typo/leftover artifact ('doc flags.') found mid-edit in pin_resolver.ex. Updated one literal moduledoc-substring test (test/letflow/engine/schemas_test.exs) whose assertion string was itself the exact phrase being retired.

(2) engine/wasm/capability_gate.ex:97 -- a real file path citation, `lib/letflow/design/req172-wasm-host-api-write-path-and-parity-suite.md`, which is the file's actual on-disk name (confirmed via `ls`); renaming the citation text would break a real cross-reference to an existing design doc, so it was left untouched. Both exceptions are called out explicitly rather than silently claimed as zero.
